title: Singleton coalitional influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $i$ be one of the $n$ coordinates. The coalitional influence of $f$ with respect to the singleton set $\{i\}$ equals its Boolean influence at coordinate $i$, namely the probability that flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
